lasso_selection: For every ratio, repetition, and dictionary size, select from the unchanged 60-penalty path by minimum independently sampled validation weak-residual MSE among converged candidates.
evaluation: Reuse the frozen held-out test trajectory and the existing full-pair evaluation statistics for every ratio; never resample or refit during evaluation.

acceptance.aggregation: root mean square across the 5 matched repetitions and 10 dictionary sizes
acceptance.lasso_advantage: sampled-pair LASSO aggregate primary RMSE is below sampled-pair raw OLS
acceptance.major_failure: Any sampled-pair LASSO fit without a selected converged candidate or any sampled-pair LASSO held-out trajectory divergence.

manuscript_instruction: Do not modify the manuscript or current/frozen figures. This R=5 ratio sweep is a preview, not an uncertainty estimate.
